title: 天体叙事：地平线日出、轨道、分屏与日食

scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.visual: A static wide shot featuring a dark horizon. A thin, vibrant red and orange horizontal line separates a solid black sky from a dark, shimmering body of water. The water reflects the warm light from the horizon line. The lighting is low-key, with the horizon serving as the primary backlighting source. The color palette is dominated by deep blacks and warm, saturated reds.

scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.visual: The camera remains static on the horizon scene. The red glow at the center of the horizon intensifies and expands upwards slightly, creating a soft gradient into the black sky. The reflections on the water become more pronounced. Lighting remains centered on the horizon with high contrast.

scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: A large, bright orange-yellow sun rises from the center of the horizon. The camera features a subtle handheld shake. Saturated light rays and lens flares extend upwards and outwards from the sun's core. The lighting is extremely bright and warm, casting a strong glow over the dark environment. The water below is now brightly illuminated in the center.

scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: A zoom-in focus on the sun, which now appears as a brilliant yellow-white orb filling the center of the frame. Intense light flares and a hazy white corona surround the sphere. The lighting is overexposed and warm. The background is a soft, reddish-brown gradient.

scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: The sun begins to dim and the color grading shifts dramatically from warm oranges to a muted, grayscale palette. The sun becomes a dark gray orb surrounded by a faint, light gray halo with thin radiating lines. The background turns dark charcoal with subtle grain.

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: A transition to a scene filled with swirling, textured orange and red clouds, resembling fire or thick nebulae. The movement is a slow, organic churn across the entire frame. The lighting is diffused and warm, with high saturation levels in the red and orange tones. There is no distinct subject, only the textured environment.

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: A bright yellow celestial sphere is centered against a dark, warm-toned background. Two faint, dotted white circular lines orbit the sphere. Small, dust-like particles float throughout the frame. The sphere glows with a soft, warm key light, creating a hazy atmosphere. The color palette is primarily gold, brown, and black.

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: The camera zooms in on a smaller, glowing red-orange orb in a deep black field. The dotted orbital lines are now wider and more out of focus. Fine white sparks or embers drift slowly across the screen. The lighting is localized to the central orb. The palette is dark and moody.

scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: A complete shift in visual style to a flat, minimalist graphic. The background is an off-white color with a subtle grid of thin gray lines. A solid red circle is positioned in the top-right quadrant. The lighting is flat and even, with a clean, high-key aesthetic and no shadows.

scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: A vertical split-screen composition. The left side is off-white with a black circle outline in the center; the right side is solid black with a solid red circle in the center. The two halves align perfectly. The lighting is graphic and flat, emphasizing the contrast between the light and dark halves.

scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: A return to the celestial imagery. A glowing yellow-orange sun on the left is being partially covered by a dark, circular silhouette moving from right to left, depicting a solar eclipse. The background is a dark, warm brown with visible grain. The lighting shifts as the sun is obscured, creating a flickering effect.

scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.visual: A total solar eclipse is achieved. A perfectly black disk is centered in the frame, surrounded by a brilliant, shimmering corona of white and golden light. Long, sharp light rays burst outward in all directions. Small white particles/flares fall toward the bottom of the frame. The lighting is high-contrast and dramatic.

scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.visual: A static close-up on a pitch-black background. A thin, glowing red line in a simple upward curve (resembling a smile) fades in slowly at the center. The line has a soft neon-like glow with no visible texture. The lighting is solely provided by the red line. The palette is strictly black and vibrant red.

provenance.implementation_detail: Celestial reference uses a seekable procedural WebGL shader and editable original captions. Tile story uses independently authored perspective cuboids, mapped wood/face textures, expression/blink/flip/jump choreography, timed camera shots and confetti; not a baked reference video.
